initial_sources.purpose: standard Spot candles for parity checks

invariants: Use venue-provided OHLCV rather than reconstructing primary candles from raw trades.
Preserve decimal values and source open/close timestamps.
Do not use unfinished candles for decisions.
Retain SHA-256 of the exact raw HTTP response bytes.
Reject malformed OHLC relationships, timestamp alignment errors, invalid wire types, and conflicting duplicate open times.
Report missing intervals between observed candles; never fabricate candles.
Never infer missing first/last intervals outside the returned range.
No private credentials, account endpoints, orders, deployment, or trading are used.
Other exchanges and brokers must implement this contract with their own official, versioned endpoint evidence; no cross-venue field semantics are assumed.
monthly_and_weekly_intervals: disabled until venue-specific calendar alignment is implemented
feature_pipeline: NativeOHLCVFeaturePipelineV1; native-only descriptive features; gaps or insufficient history block decision readiness
